name: The St. Regis Jakarta
positioning: St. Regis hotel in Jakarta's Golden Triangle, with Indonesian culture woven into its design and 24-hour butler service in every room
best_for: Business travelers who want a base near Jakarta's main business districts
Families who want kids' amenities and a pool with a children's pool

facts.text: The hotel is set within Jakarta's Golden Triangle, near the city's three main business districts.
The address is Rajawali Place on Jalan HR Rasuna Said, in Setiabudi, South Jakarta.
Indonesian culture is woven into the hotel's spaces, combining local refinement with minimalist design.
Rooms and suites are decorated in ivory tones with bronze accents.
The 24-hour St. Regis Butler Service is available in every room and suite.
Butler services include packing and unpacking, pressing and a nightly turndown.
The St. Regis Spa has six treatment rooms, including two for couples.
The spa features a sauna, a steam room and a whirlpool.
The outdoor pool area includes a kids' pool, a whirlpool and a pool bar.
The Drawing Room has kinetic light chandeliers and hosts a sabrage tradition on weekends.
Family amenities include themed bathrobes, playful tents and toys.

highlights.text: The Great Hall has a ceiling display that pays tribute to Indonesian culture and the St. Regis legacy of music and performance.
The pool area has a bohemian style with Batik-inspired art.
The Caroline Astor Suite has locally designed furnishings exclusive to The St. Regis Jakarta.
The St. Regis Bar has a mural that narrates Javanese spiritualism, music and communal harmony.

considerations.text: This is a city business-district setting: the hotel sits in the Golden Triangle near Jakarta's main business districts.
The closest airport is Halim Perdanakusuma International Airport.
